message:
Fix Codecov badge URL (#42)

* Fix Codecov badge URL to point to gothinkster org and main branch

* fix: update License badge URL from master to main

pr.title: Fix Codecov badge URL
pr.body:
The Codecov badge was pointing to the wrong repository (`wangzitian0/golang-gin-realworld-example-app`) and wrong branch (`master`).

This PR fixes it to point to:
- Organization: `gothinkster`
- Branch: `main`

**Note:** For the badge to work properly, you also need to:
1. Set up the `CODECOV_TOKEN` secret in the repository settings (see `.github/SETUP.md` for instructions)
2. Ensure coverage reports are being uploaded successfully

diff:
diff --git a/.travis.yml b/.travis.yml
index dfd0ce5..8f135c9 100644
--- a/.travis.yml
+++ b/.travis.yml
@@ -20,4 +20,5 @@ script:
   - bash ./scripts/coverage.sh
 
 after_success:
-  - bash <(curl -s https://codecov.io/bash)
+  - go install github.com/mattn/goveralls@latest
+  - goveralls -coverprofile=coverage.out -service=travis-ci
diff --git a/readme.md b/readme.md
index 9fa735d..5958337 100644
--- a/readme.md
+++ b/readme.md
@@ -2,8 +2,8 @@
 
 
 [![CI](https://github.com/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
-[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/wangzitian0/golang-gin-realworld-example-app/branch/master/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/wangzitian0/golang-gin-realworld-example-app)
-[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://github.com/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app/blob/master/LICENSE)
+[![Coverage Status](https://coveralls.io/repos/github/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://coveralls.io/github/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app?branch=main)
+[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://github.com/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app/blob/main/LICENSE)
 [![GoDoc](https://godoc.org/github.com/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app?status.svg)](https://godoc.org/github.com/gothinkster/golang-gin-realworld-example-app)
 
 > ### Golang/Gin codebase containing real world examples (CRUD, auth, advanced patterns, etc) that adheres to the [RealWorld](https://github.com/gothinkster/realworld) spec and API.
diff --git a/scripts/coverage.sh b/scripts/coverage.sh
index d753e4a..1a02391 100755
--- a/scripts/coverage.sh
+++ b/scripts/coverage.sh
@@ -4,14 +4,14 @@ set -e
 
 # http://stackoverflow.com/a/21142256/2055281
 
-echo "mode: atomic" > coverage.txt
+echo "mode: atomic" > coverage.out
 
 for d in $(find ./* -maxdepth 10 -type d); do
     if ls $d/*.go &> /dev/null; then
         go test  -coverprofile=profile.out -covermode=atomic $d
         if [ -f profile.out ]; then
             echo "$(pwd)"
-            cat profile.out | grep -v "mode: " >> coverage.txt
+            cat profile.out | grep -v "mode: " >> coverage.out
             rm profile.out
         fi
     fi

explanation.what: readme.md の Codecov バッジを Coveralls バッジに置き換え、License バッジのリンク先ブランチを master から main に修正した。あわせて .travis.yml の after_success を `codecov.io/bash` の実行から `goveralls` によるCoverallsアップロードに変更し、scripts/coverage.sh の出力先ファイル名を coverage.txt から coverage.out に変更した。
explanation.why: PRタイトルは「Codecov バッジURLの修正」だが、PR本文によれば元々のバッジは誤って `wangzitian0/golang-gin-realworld-example-app`(誤ったorg)・masterブランチ(存在しないブランチ)を指しており、正しくは `gothinkster` org・`main` ブランチを指すべきだった。コミット本体の変更はそれに留まらず、カバレッジサービス自体をCodecovからCoverallsに切り替えている。CODECOV_TOKENの設定が必要な運用上の負担を避け、goveralls(Travis CI向けのシンプルな認証)に乗り換えたものと考えられるが、その判断の直接的な記述はPR本文中には無い。

highlights.note: Codecovバッジ→Coverallsバッジへの置き換え
after_success を codecov.io/bash から goveralls に変更
